title: OptiMin
body:
OptiMin

Minimal. Stable. Optimized.
A lightweight Fabric 1.20.1 modpack focused entirely on performance and clean gameplay.

## 🚀 What is OptiMin? OptiMin is a carefully curated **Fabric 1.20.1 optimization modpack** designed to: - Maximize FPS - Reduce memory usage - Improve chunk & entity rendering - Lower CPU load - Maintain vanilla gameplay feel - Stay minimal and stable This modpack does **not** add gameplay content. It only improves performance, visuals, and user experience. ## 🎯 Target - Low-end PCs - Heavy multiplayer usage - Large modded servers - Players wanting smooth gameplay without gameplay changes ## ⚙️ Performance Stack ### Rendering Optimizations - **Sodium** – Complete rendering engine rewrite for massive FPS gains - **ImmediatelyFast** – UI & HUD rendering optimizations - **More Culling** – Advanced block face culling - **EntityCulling** – Prevents rendering unseen entities - **FerriteCore** – Memory usage reduction - **Lithium** – Game logic optimizations (AI, physics, ticking) - **BadOptimizations** – Micro-optimizations across systems ### Background Resource Management - **Dynamic FPS** – Reduces usage when game is unfocused - **FPS Reducer** – Smart frame limiting when idle - **ServerCore** – Server-side performance improvements ### Visual & UX Enhancements (Lightweight) - 3D Skin Layers - Chat Heads - Chat Animation - Jade (block/entity tooltips) - JourneyMap - JEI - OptiGUI - Simple Voice Chat - Essential ### Core Dependencies - Fabric API - Fabric Language Kotlin - Cloth Config - Mod Menu - Crash Assistant ## 📦 Included Mods ``` - 3d\-Skin\-Layers [1\.10\.2] by tr7zw (skinlayers3d\-fabric\-1\.10\.2\-mc1\.20\.1\.jar) - BadOptimizations [2\.4\.1] by Thosea (BadOptimizations\-2\.4\.1\-1\.20\.1\.jar) - Chat Heads [0\.15\.0] by dzwdz, Fourmisain (chat\_heads\-0\.15\.0\-fabric\-1\.20\.jar) - ChatAnimation [1\.1\.3] by Ezzenix (chatanimation\-fabric\-1\.20\.1\-1\.1\.3\.jar) - Cloth Config v11 [11\.1\.136] by shedaniel (cloth\-config\-11\.1\.136\-fabric\.jar) - Crash Assistant [1\.10\.30] by KostromDan (CrashAssistant\-fabric\-1\.19\-1\.21\.4\-1\.10\.30\.jar) - Dynamic FPS [3\.11\.4] by juliand665, LostLuma (dynamic\-fps\-3\.11\.4\+minecraft\-1\.20\.0\-fabric\.jar) - EntityCulling [1\.9\.5] by tr7zw (entityculling\-fabric\-1\.9\.5\-mc1\.20\.1\.jar) - FPS Reducer [1\.20\-2\.5] by bre2el (FpsReducer2\-fabric\-1\.20\-2\.5\.jar) - Fabric API [0\.92\.7\+1\.20\.1] by FabricMC (fabric\-api\-0\.92\.7\+1\.20\.1\.jar) - Fabric Language Kotlin [1\.13\.9\+kotlin\.2\.3\.10] by FabricMC (fabric\-language\-kotlin\-1\.13\.9\+kotlin\.2\.3\.10\.jar) - FerriteCore [6\.0\.1] by malte0811 (ferritecore\-6\.0\.1\-fabric\.jar) - ImmediatelyFast [1\.5\.4\+1\.20\.4] by RK\_01 (ImmediatelyFast\-Fabric\-1\.5\.4\+1\.20\.4\.jar) - Jade [11\.13\.1\+fabric] by Snownee (Jade\-1\.20\-Fabric\-11\.13\.1\.jar) - Journeymap [5\.10\.3] by Mysticdrew, Techbrew (journeymap\-1\.20\.1\-5\.10\.3\-fabric\.jar) - Just Enough Items [15\.20\.0\.129] by mezz (jei\-1\.20\.1\-fabric\-15\.20\.0\.129\.jar) - Lithium [0\.11\.4] by JellySquid, 2No2Name (lithium\-fabric\-mc1\.20\.1\-0\.11\.4\.jar) - Mod Menu [7\.2\.2] by Prospector, haykam821, TerraformersMC (modmenu\-7\.2\.2\.jar) - More Culling [1\.20\.1\-0\.24\.5] by FX \- PR0CESS (moreculling\-1\.20\.1\-0\.24\.5\.jar) - OptiGUI [2\.3\.0\-beta\.9\+1\.20] by opekope2 (optigui\-2\.3\.0\-beta\.9\+1\.20\.jar) - ServerCore [1\.5\.2\+1\.20\.1] by Wesley1808 (servercore\-fabric\-1\.5\.2\+1\.20\.1\.jar) - Simple Voice Chat [1\.20\.1\-2\.6\.12] by Max Henkel (voicechat\-fabric\-1\.20\.1\-2\.6\.12\.jar) - Sodium [0\.5\.13\+mc1\.20\.1] by JellySquid \(jellysquid3\) (sodium\-fabric\-0\.5\.13\+mc1\.20\.1\.jar) - essential\-container [1\.0\.0] (Essential\_1\-3\-10\-6\_fabric\_1\-20\-1\.jar) ``` --- ## 🧠 Why Fabric? Fabric was chosen because it: - Is lightweight - Loads faster than Forge/NeoForge - Has lower overhead - Provides the best optimization ecosystem (Sodium + Lithium + FerriteCore stack) This ensures maximum compatibility and minimum performance impact. ## 💻 Recommended Settings For best performance: - Use 6–8GB RAM maximum (more is not always better) - Enable VSync OFF - Use fullscreen mode - Reduce simulation distance if CPU bound - Let Sodium handle advanced rendering settings ## 🔌 Server Compatibility OptiMin is fully compatible with: - Vanilla servers - Fabric servers - Most NeoForge/Forge servers (client-side mods only) ServerCore improves performance when installed server-side. ## 🛠 Installation 1. Install .mrpack or .zip 2. Launch the game ## 🐞 Issues & Support If you encounter crashes: - Check the Crash Assistant report - Verify mod version compatibility - Avoid adding unknown optimization mods that conflict with Sodium ## 📜 License This modpack includes mods developed by their respective authors. All credits belong to the original creators.

Built for performance.
